source: Identity: body-annotations-male-cns-v1.0-minconf-0.5.feather [type] via bodyId renamed malecns_body_id. ROI: syn-points-male-cns-v1.0-minconf-0.5.feather column body, joined on malecns_body_id. Not the derived CPG parquet. Not type-level ROI totals. Soma XYZ / somaNeuromere unused. Pugliese MANC IDs appear only under DNg100.pugliese_reference.

assignment.signal: T#_score = PreSyn+PostSyn in LegNp(T#)(L)+LegNp(T#)(R); then L vs R
assignment.ambiguous_policy: assigned_segment=null, assignment_status=AMBIGUOUS; never soma-Z or somaNeuromere

i2_type_provenance.source: Pugliese et al. 2025 (PMC13142387): E1=IN17A001, E2=INXXX466, E3=IN19B012, I1=IN16B036, I2=IN19A007
i2_type_provenance.note: I2 is IN19A007: six T1/T2/T3 copies, predicted GABAergic. IN19B007 exists in MaleCNS (two neurons) and was an incorrect earlier I2 assignment.

manc_vms16.note: Pugliese MANC T1 table row 16 is vMS16, not DNg100. MaleCNS annotations independently give bodyId 10056 type DNg100 (DNg100_R). Same integer, different reconstructed specimen/dataset. Do not join on the integer. MaleCNS DNg100_R's curated mancBodyid/mancType is correspondence to MANC DNg100 10093, not to this vMS16 row.

manc_correspondence.note: Curated cross-dataset correspondence. Same annotated cell type on a different reconstructed specimen. Not integer identity of malecns_body_id.

left.note: MaleCNS annotations[type == DNg100]. Same annotated cell type as Pugliese's MANC DNg100, different reconstructed specimen. manc_correspondence is the curated mancBodyid field, not identity.

manc_correspondence.note: Curated cross-dataset correspondence. Same annotated cell type on a different reconstructed specimen. Not integer identity of malecns_body_id.

right.note: MaleCNS annotations[type == DNg100]. Same annotated cell type as Pugliese's MANC DNg100, different reconstructed specimen. manc_correspondence is the curated mancBodyid field, not identity.

malecns.note: Looked up by type == DNg100 in the official MaleCNS annotation feather. Same annotated cell type as Pugliese MANC DNg100, different specimen. manc_correspondence copies mancBodyid/mancType; it is not identity. MANC table body 10056 is vMS16. MaleCNS bodyId 10056 is independently DNg100_R.
